punchline: Marcus Aurelius sold his own treasures before asking anyone else for money.
thirty_sec: With the treasury empty during the Marcomannic war, Marcus Aurelius auctioned imperial gold cups, crystal and silk in Trajan's Forum for two months instead of taxing the provinces, then refunded buyers who wanted to give things back.
question: What is one comfort of your own you could give up before you ask others to give something up?
key_contrast: He paid from his own cupboards instead of taxing others.
